$description: Output schema for the ERDDAP data fusion planner — map from query_id to fusion plan

subqueries.server: <string: ERDDAP server base URL from registry>
ancillary_variables: <auto-detected from CF ancillary_variables attribute on requested vars; empty list if none>
urls: <full ERDDAP REST API URL(s); 1 URL normally, 2 if antimeridian split>
subqueries.antimeridian_split: <boolean: whether longitude range was split at the antimeridian>

<vertical_dim_name>.value: <float, only if dataset has altitude/zlev/depth dimension>

spatial_coverage.latitude_fraction: <float 0-1: fraction of query lat range covered by dataset>
spatial_coverage.longitude_fraction: <float 0-1: fraction of query lon range covered by dataset>

<dataset_id>.resolution_seconds: <float or null: time spacing from DAS for grids, null for tables>

unit_harmonization_target.<standard_name>: <chosen target unit — most common unit among datasets sharing this standard_name in the query>

notes: ancillary_variables: parsed from the CF ancillary_variables attribute on each requested variable. Split on whitespace to get individual variable names. Only include variables that actually exist in the dataset's DDS.

unit_conversions: detect when >=2 datasets in the same query measure the same physical quantity (identical CF standard_name) but use different units. The target unit is the most frequent unit for that standard_name; if tied, prefer degree_C over kelvin. Conversion formula: target_value = source_value * scale + offset. For kelvin to degree_C: scale=1.0, offset=-273.15. Omit the entry for variables already in the target unit or when no harmonization is needed.

spatial_coverage: compute the fraction of the query's spatial domain covered by the dataset's actual coordinate range. Formula: fraction = overlap_range / query_range, where overlap = [max(query_min, dataset_min), min(query_max, dataset_max)]. Longitude comparison must account for coordinate convention differences.

temporal_alignment: for gridded datasets, resolution_seconds comes from the time variable's spacing attribute in DAS. Label mapping: 86400 -> 'daily', 691200 -> '8-day', 2592000 -> 'monthly'. For table datasets: resolution_seconds is null and label is 'irregular'.
longitude values in constraints must be in the dataset's native coordinate system
Dimension constraints in griddap URLs must follow the dimension order declared in the dataset's DDS
Generated URLs should use .csv as the file type
griddap URLs use bracket-based [(start):stride:(stop)] syntax; tabledap URLs use var1,var2&constraint1&... syntax with >= and <= operators
Ancillary variables must be included as additional variables in griddap/tabledap URLs with matching dimension constraints
The vertical dimension name varies by dataset (altitude, zlev, etc.) — use the actual dimension name from DDS
